what_it_does: Hindustan Aeronautics Limited manufactures, repairs, overhauls, and upgrades aircraft, helicopters, aero-engines, and avionics. It primarily serves national and international defense customers, including the Indian Armed Forces, and civil customers, generating revenue through product sales and maintenance services.

segments.name: Repair and Maintenance of Aircraft, Helicopters and Engines

other_facts: HAL has 30 national plants and 5 national offices.
Export share stands at 1.58% of total turnover in FY 2025-26.
The company has 20 Divisions and 10 R&D Centres.
